verdict.rationale: Viam documents ready-made drivers pulled automatically from its Registry once you specify a hardware model in config, plus a searchable model catalog and a Discovery service. Components expose uniform, brand-agnostic APIs (e.g., every camera uses GetImage(), and sensors are likewise standardized), which serves as the standard-interface equivalent of message types. Cameras are clearly covered, but lidar, IMU, and GPS drivers are never specifically evidenced. missing for 10: explicit evidence of ready-made lidar, IMU, and GPS drivers or APIs, documentation of the standard data/message types for those sensors, independent hands-on corroboration.
